faq.q: Is Warhammer Survivors multiplayer or co-op?
faq.a: No. It is single-player only; the soldiers that follow you are squad followers, not a second player.
Max the weapon, hold its companion passive (level 1 is enough for most), then open the next elite or boss chest.

faq.q: How do I beat the Extremis bosses?
faq.a: Each boss arrives at 25:00 and only takes damage from one specific evolved weapon, such as Gauntlets of Ultramar for the Norn Emissary.

faq.q: How do I unlock more champions?
faq.a: Rescue them on stages, finish Objectives, collect Paint Pots or buy them with coins; Amalia Novena (400 coins) is the best early buy.

faq.q: How do I unlock new maps?
faq.a: Reach a character level on the previous map: 20, then 40, 50 and 60. 'Eavy Metal mode opens Desert Wasteland and Gnarlwood.

faq.q: Does demo progress carry over to the full game?
faq.a: No. Start progression in the full game; only Xbox Play Anywhere shares saves across Xbox and Microsoft PC.
No redeem codes. Incantations typed into the Secrets menu unlock rewards instead.
